title: Reading and Synthesis: Borges
goal: Read an original text about Borges and combine cleft sentences, fronting and contrastive 'no ... sino' in a short commentary.

items: Read a short text about a writer and his best-known story and answer questions about it.
Spot cleft sentences, fronting and 'no ... sino' in a text.
Combine the unit's three emphasis tools in a short commentary on a book.
Use words for stories of mystery and time, such as 'laberinto', 'enigma' and 'bifurcación'.
